Class AutoAim

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.subsystems.AutoAim
All Implemented Interfaces:
dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
public final class AutoAim extends Object implements dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
Stationary, vision-guided aiming. Call periodic() once per OpMode loop. Initialize Vision, Turret, Hood and Flywheel first. Never actuates the feeder. CELL coordinates must be validated as robot-centered inches; turret zero is forward.
